text: いいよ　とうちゃん　だって　＊と　おともだちに　なれたもん！

structure.jp: いいよ　とうちゃん
＊と　おともだちに　なれたもん！
structure.en: I got to become friends with ＊!

patterns.name: 〜もの (reason)
patterns.explanation: もん is the childish spoken form of もの, put at the end to give your reason, often together with だって. なれたもん = 'because I got to become that!'

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: なれる is the 'can do' form of なる, 'become'. なれた = 'was able to become'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: おともだちに　なれた
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what someone turns into. おともだちになれた = 'was able to become friends'.
